content.text:
Confirmed: commit 6659b98 renamed only the main package (`com.github.piotr.rusin` → `com.github.piotr_rusin`) but left the test file's package under the old `piotr.rusin` path, creating the mismatch that commit fdab258 later fixed.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 6659b989e0a57d67df00983f53ba391af61f70a6

## Reasoning
(1) I traced the history of the file renamed in the fix (`YuleApplicationTests.java`) and its main-source counterpart (`YuleApplication.java`) using `git log --diff-filter=R` to find all rename events involving the `piotr`/`piotr_rusin` package paths.

(2) Commit `6659b98` renamed `src/main/java/com/github/piotr/rusin/yule/YuleApplication.java` to `src/main/java/com/github/piotr_rusin/yule/YuleApplication.java`, updating the package declaration from `com.github.piotr.rusin.yule` to `com.github.piotr_rusin.yule`. However, this commit only touched the main source file — it did not perform the corresponding rename/update on the test file, which remained at `src/test/java/com/github/piotr/rusin/yule/YuleApplicationTests.java` with the old package declaration `com.github.piotr.rusin.yule`.

(3) This left the test tree out of sync with the main tree for roughly three months (Jan 9, 2017 → Mar 29, 2017), until commit `fdab258` finally renamed the test file and corrected its package declaration to match. The `git show --stat` of `6659b98` confirms it is a single-file change limited to `src/main`, with no accompanying test-file update — directly matching the inverse of the bug fix.

I'm highly confident in this attribution: the rename/fix in `fdab258` is the exact mirror image of the incomplete rename in `6659b98`, and no other commit touches these paths in between.
